ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely concentrated high-intensity mottling and speckling clusters localized at the distal tips: left lobe cluster [approx. x: 0.0-0.15, y: 0.2-0.7] and right lobe cluster [approx. x: 0.85-1.0, y: 0.1-0.5].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 14% of the fluke's total vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical jagged boundary; right lobe trailing edge exhibits five distinct, high-amplitude peaks (serrations); left lobe exhibits higher-frequency, lower-amplitude variations along the continuous linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex sweep trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips, with a local transition to slight concavity immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast roughly circular pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization at the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks or scratches) visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the low-intensity pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical pale lesion or scar located approximately 5% to the right of the central notch midline; significant distal tip trauma/encrustation from parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the frequency and amplitude of trailing edge serrations between the left and right lobes.
